profile.summary: A private research university founded in 1898 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It is known for experiential learning and has campuses in several cities. Its Oakland campus is home to Mills College at Northeastern.

review.notes: Agenda names 'Northeastern University' with a Boston, MA location, and Mills College (Oakland) is part of Northeastern; the ProPublica record (Boston, EIN 04-1679980, 501(c)(3)) and the Northeastern About and Mills pages support legal name, org type, headquarters, website, founding year and the neutral summary. The 'Lead by Learning' program name was not found on a fetched page, but the summary does not claim anything about it.
